items.title: Implementing FreeCell SuperMoves: Capacity Rules and Edge Cases
items.description: FreeCell looks simple until a player tries to move a long descending run and the interface refuses. The useful programming lesson is that a legal “supermove” is not a special card rule. It is a compact way of representing a sequence of ordinary single-card moves through temporary storage.
